messages:
elena: Quick RFC follow-up from the packaging sync — proposal summary: adopt a patchstream-first approach for onprem/airgapped, plus a lightweight operator sidecar that handles activation windows, tombstones, and resume tokens. Goal: reduce initial seed size and enable faster hotpatches without forcing full-image swaps.

devin: sounds good in theory. main risk is operator complexity and operator trust boundaries. do we keep signature verification in the sidecar or the operator? :thinking: 

elena: prefer sidecar for verification (local trust) + operator for policy (when to activate). reasoning: sidecar can run with least privilege to verify blobs and present a signed activation intent to the operator. operator validates intent against cluster policy.

ty: curious about failure modes: what if sidecar verifies and then node reboots before activation? tombstone handling..?

morgan: add a short-lived activation lease in the intent reply. operator only applies within lease window. if reboot happens, sidecar either replays intent (if KV persisted) or we fall back to full-image swap. keep replays idempotent.

devin: agree on lease idea. also need manifest schema change: include component-level compat anchors and a 'fallback-image' pointer. example manifest snippet:```manifest_version: 2
components:
  - name: runtime
    hash: "sha256:..."
    compat_anchors: ["1.x", "2.3.x"]
    fallback: "oci://registry/redwood/runtime:1.3.2"
```

elena: exactly. the compat_anchors let operator decide whether a progressive delta is safe or if we require monolithic apply.

ty: storage/transport question: do we stream delta patches as a single content-addressed tar or as chunked fragments with index? tradeoff: resumability v/s operator memory pressure.

morgan: chunked fragments plus small index (index only contains chunk refs, hashes, and component map). operator/sidecar can fetch missing chunks from local airgap media or proxy. we should cap concurrent rehydrate workers to avoid OOM on constrained nodes.

devin: +1. also recommend we expose a simple CLI for offline media preparation: `redwood pack create-patch --manifest manifest.yaml --out patch.tar` so field ops can pre-build patchstream bundles.

ops-bot: deploy-bot: created ticket RW-ENG-1452 for 'offline bundle CLI and operator API' by @elena. ETA 2w.

elena: followups/concerns: 1) operator <-> sidecar protocol (REST local socket vs CRD watch?) 2) rollback signal shape (operator needs a compact rollback marker) 3) telemetry/forensics for airgapped envs.

ty: for 1) local unix socket RPC is simplest (no k8s auth hoops) for node-local verification. operator can watch node CRD for activation intents. for airgapped we must support non-k8s nodes too (systemd sidecar + local file drop that operator scans).

morgan: for 2) rollback marker = signed tombstone with range hash + activation id. minimal shape: `activation_id, component_set, prev_hash, reason_code, signer`. operator enforces tombstone TTL and retention policy.

devin: can we reuse existing manifest-merkle code to compute range hashes? less new surface area.

elena: yes reuse merkle libs. add a helper `redwood manifest rangesum --range components/runtime` for ops.

ty: tests: we need a simulator that can emulate partial chunk loss + replaying intents. also a fuzz harness for manifest compat_anchors evaluation.

morgan: perf: ensure small patches (<50MB) are common. fallback to full-image only for major-milestone rollouts. autosuggest quantization: consider compressing model shards separately from runtime blobs to avoid decompressing large model files during operator activation.

devin: security: sidecar must do strict signature validation and reject unknown signers. operator policy can map allowed signers per-cluster. document key-rotation procedure and escrow path.

ops-bot: note: @devin added RW-SPEC-223 to vendor spec board: add signer mapping and rotation flow.

elena: Decision (informal): ship patchstream-first with chunked fragments + small index, sidecar does verification + intent signing, operator validates intent and controls activation window via lease. fallback full-image apply supported as a backstop. follow-ups: 1) RFC PR enumerating sidecar operator RPC/CRD shapes (owner: @elena, due EOW) 2) offline bundle CLI + patch packing (owner: @devin) 3) test harness + simulator (owner: @ty) 4) security key-rotation doc (owner: @morgan).

morgan: acked. will start a draft doc for rollback marker shape.

ty: will prototype simulator with random chunk loss and activation race interleavings.

devin: starting CLI stub today, will post link to repo.

elena: thanks all — I'll open the PR with API sketches and manifest delta examples. if anyone wants to object or add constraints, ping me inline here. :thumbsup:
